source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 788 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 788 was established by Ordinance No. 27214, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11, 2008. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 788 is established on property generally located on the south side of Skillman Street, east of Merriman Parkway. The size of PD 788 is approximately 10.99 acres. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article:

(1) FACADE means any separate face of a building, including parapet walls and omitted wall lines, or any part of a building that encloses usable space. Where separate faces are oriented the same direction, or in directions within 45 degrees of one another, they are considered part of a single facade.

(2) TREE PLANTING ZONE means the area parallel to and between 2.5 and 20 feet from the back of the projected street curb.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 788A: development plan. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 788A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A- 4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard.

(1) Except as provided in this subsection, minimum front yard is as shown on the development plan.

(2) Steps, stairs, and required hand rails may encroach into the front yard and are not required to be shown on the development plan.

(b) Side and rear yard.

(1) Except as provided in this subsection, minimum side and rear yards at the perimeter of the Property are 10 feet as shown on the development plan.

(2) No side and rear yards are required on individual lots.

(3) Steps, stairs, and required hand rails may encroach into the side and rear yards at the perimeter of the Property and are not required to be shown on the development plan.

(c) Density. Maximum number of dwelling units is 362.

(d) Floor area ratio. No maximum floor area ratio.

(e) Height.

(1) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not exceed a one-to-three residential proximity slope originating on private property in an R, R(A), D, D(A), TH, or TH(A) district. Exception: Except for chimneys, those structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the residential proximity slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the residential proximity slope, whichever is less. Chimneys may project through the residential proximity slope to a height 12 feet above the residential proximity slope and 12 feet above the maximum structure height.

(2) Maximum height. Unless further restricted in Paragraph (1), maximum structure height is 60 feet.

(f) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 70 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(g) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(h) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade for parking garages is six. Except as shown on the development plan, maximum number of stories above grade for all other structures is four. (Ord. Nos. 27214; 29422)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Landscape buffers. Perimeter landscape buffer strips are not required between lots within this district.

(c) Parking structures.

(1) Parking lot trees are not required at parking structures.

(2) Pavement within parking structures is not included in the calculation of all outdoor vehicular pavement area for purposes of Section 51A-10.126(d).

(d) Parkway trees.

(1) Location. Parkway trees must be located within the tree planting zone.

(2) Number. The minimum number of required parkway trees is determined by dividing the number of feet of street frontage, excluding visibility triangles, by 25. Fractions are rounded to the nearest whole number, with .5 being rounded up to the next higher whole number.

(3) Type. Parkway trees must be recommended for local area use by the building official.

(4) Height and caliper. Parkway trees must have a minimum height of 14 feet and a minimum caliper of 3.5 inches measured at a point 12 inches above the root ball at the time of installation.

(5) Spacing. Parkway trees must be spaced as uniformly as practicable, but must be within 50 feet of the trunk of another required tree.

(6) Credit. Parkway trees count toward site tree and street tree requirements.

(e) Sidewalks.

(1) A minimum six-foot-wide sidewalk with at least four feet of unobstructed width must be provided along Skillman Street.

(2) Sidewalks must be located in an area parallel to and within 2.5 feet to 15 feet of the back of the projected street curb.
(3) If a sidewalk is located in the front yard, the property owner must dedicate a sidewalk easement to the city to assure its availability to the public as a permanent pedestrian way.

(f) Maintenance. Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 27214; 29422)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Parking Structures
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.113. PARKING STRUCTURES.

(a) Any portion of a parking structure not wrapped by the main structure must have a facade that is similar in materials, architecture, and appearance to the facade of the main structure or the adjacent structure.

(b) Breaks in a parking structure facade not exceeding 40 feet in width are permitted at entrances and exits.

(c) Openings in a parking structure facade may not exceed 50 percent of the total parking structure facade area. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Roadway Improvements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.114. ROADWAY IMPROVEMENTS.

A two-lane egress with sufficient throat depth for vehicular storage and a one-lane ingress must be provided before the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any development over 30 units per acre. (Ord. Nos. 27214; 29422)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.116. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 27214)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-788.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 27214)
